It pins: PythonResolver — cross-file edges (M8 gate); Mixed TS + Python indexRepo — no cross-talk (M8 gate); PythonResolver — module bindings (M8 NICE-5).
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of python-resolver
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
